name: reva-governance
description: Authorizes every Claude Code tool call and prompt against your organization's Reva policies before it runs

auth_token.title: Reva Auth Token
auth_token.description: Authenticates every request this plugin makes to Reva — PDP evaluation (every tool call and prompt) and entity ingestion at session start. Issued by Reva for your tenant.

host.title: Reva Host
host.description: Your Reva tenant's API host, for example api.example.reva.ai. Leave blank to use the default, api.reva.ai.
